title: When Image Generation Goes Wrong: A Safety Analysis of Stable Diffusion Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the demographic distribution of individuals in generated images across different harmful prompt categories (e.g., violence, NSFW) by classifying their perceived race using the Deepface facial recognition tool.

Conducting visual and quantitative analysis of generated images to compare how models depict male versus female bodies in response to NSFW prompts, specifically examining anatomical accuracy, cropping patterns, and the manifestation of sexual characteristics.
